- New native desktop GUI (`ripdl-gui`, built on `eframe`/`egui`): fast startup,
  virtualized scrolling, Lucide vector icons, Light and Dark themes persisted
  across launches, interactive Speed & Limits controls, and zero WebView2
  overhead.
- First-run Setup Wizard (Download folder, browser extension setup, speed cap &
  network bonding): guides fresh installs in 3 skippable steps while never
  interrupting existing users on upgrade.
- New browser extension welcome page (`welcome.html`), `"Setup guide"` link in
  the extension popup, and `ripdl register-host --open-welcome` for one-step
  native host pairing and diagnostics.
- Settings Browser tab upgraded with one-click native-host registration, managed
  extension folder copy/open, plugin `.js` script installer, and window/tray
  preferences.
